app.title: OpenDPD Studio
session.required.title: Session required
session.required.body: This page needs the local session created by the URL that `opendpd gui` printed. Open that URL again, or paste the bootstrap token below.
session.token.label: Bootstrap token
session.token.invalid: The token is not valid for the running server. Restart `opendpd gui` and use the URL it prints.
state.error.title: Something went wrong
state.empty.title: Nothing here yet
state.disconnected.title: Live updates disconnected
state.disconnected.body: Reconnecting… last update {time}. The run keeps going on the server; refresh to fetch the latest snapshot.
status.stale: Log disconnected: no heartbeat for over a minute
evidence.mock.hint: Mock data for interface development; not a computed result and never exportable.
evidence.pa_modeling.hint: How well the model reproduces the measured PA output. Not a DPD result.
evidence.dpd_surrogate.hint: DPD evaluated against the trained PA model, not against a real PA.
evidence.dpd_measured.hint: DPD evaluated with real PA measurements.
home.title: Home
home.example.title: Example: DPA_200MHz
home.example.body: Built-in measured data from a 200 MHz digital PA. Register it, then train the smoke recipe to see the whole workflow in a few minutes.
home.noRuns: No runs yet. Start with the example dataset and a smoke recipe.
datasets.title: Datasets
datasets.empty: No datasets registered. Register the built-in example or import your own data.
experiments.title: Experiments
form.title: New experiment
form.recipe.help: A recipe fixes the model and training settings for a purpose. Smoke recipes prove the pipeline; they are not benchmarks.
form.paRun.help: DPD training needs a succeeded PA model run on the same dataset.
form.paRun.none: No succeeded PA run on this dataset yet.
form.device.untested: no recorded evidence for this model on {device}
form.name: Name (optional)
form.smokeBanner: Smoke recipe: a few epochs to prove the pipeline. Results are not a benchmark.
run.title: Run
run.cancel.confirm: Cancel this run? Artifacts produced so far are kept.
run.metrics.title: Validation and test metrics per epoch
run.metrics.empty: Metrics appear after the first epoch.
run.next.failed: Read the error and hint, fix the configuration, then retry as a new run.
run.next.interrupted: The service stopped while this run was active. Retry as a new run.
run.next.cancelled: Cancelled on request. Retry as a new run if needed.
run.next.succeeded: Open the result to see metrics with their evidence type.
run.next.queued: Waiting for a free device. Cancel if you no longer need it.
run.artifacts.empty: Artifacts are registered when the run finishes.
run.artifacts.incomplete: One or more required artifacts are missing; the manifest is incomplete.
results.title: Results
results.empty: No results yet. A result is written when a PA or DPD run succeeds.
settings.title: Settings
settings.devices.note: Detected means the driver reports the device. Tested means a model has recorded evidence on it. One does not imply the other.
gallery.title: Component gallery
gallery.body: Every domain component rendered on fixed mock fixtures generated from the contract examples. Nothing here is a computed result.
gallery.perf: Performance probe: PSD with {psd} points × {traces} traces and an I/Q window of {iq} samples rendered in {ms} ms.
diff.title: Configuration differences
chart.spectrum.title: Power spectral density
chart.iq.title: I/Q time window
datasets.import.title: Import my data
datasets.import.upload.help: CSV, .npy or .npz up to 2 GB; it is stored under the workspace imports folder and never anywhere else.
datasets.import.noFiles: No CSV / .npy / .npz files here. Copy files into the import root or upload one.
datasets.import.mapping.help: Which column holds each logical signal. Guessed from the headers; fix any mistake here, including swapped I/Q.
datasets.import.signal.help: Needed by the evaluation profile; without them formal metrics are blocked, not guessed.
datasets.import.name: Display name
datasets.detail.versions.empty: Only raw-v1 (built-in datasets keep their original split).
datasets.detail.doctor.empty: No report yet. The doctor checks NaN/Inf, length, outliers, clipping plateaus, delay, gain, amplitude, bandwidth and metadata, and says which evaluations would be unreliable.
datasets.detail.doctor.blocked: Formal evaluation is blocked until the error items are resolved.
datasets.preprocess.title: Preprocess (creates a new version)
datasets.preprocess.help: Raw files are never modified. Preview first; a version is written only when you confirm. Normalisation is fitted on the training split only.
datasets.preprocess.normalize: Normalise by the training-split input peak
datasets.import.pick: Pick a file on the left (or upload one) to inspect it.
datasets.preprocess.version.help: Letters, digits, dots, dashes; e.g. aligned-v1. Cannot overwrite an existing version.
results.detail.profile.help: Every registered profile is scored from the same best checkpoint; the configured one is the primary result.
results.detail.definitions.help: What each score means under {profile} v{version}. Names, formulas and better-directions come from the registry, not from the page.
form.profile.help: The definition behind every score of the result. Every registered profile is also stored; this one is shown first.
form.import.help: A JSON experiment configuration (exported from a run or written by hand). It is validated by the server and submitted as is.
form.imported: Imported configuration from {source}. The fields above are not applied; the server validates and runs exactly this configuration.
run.lineage.help: Read from resolved configurations: which checkpoints this run used and which runs used it.
run.lineage.empty: This run neither uses nor is used by another run.
run.apply: Apply DPD to the test split…
run.apply.title: Apply this DPD to the test split
run.apply.help: Exports u = DPD(x), the pre-distorted PA input, and scores y = PA(u) through the chosen surrogate against the same linear target as the training result. The export is a PA input, not a PA output, and does not by itself show linearisation.
run.apply.surrogate.help: Another succeeded PA run of the same dataset gives a new, separately stored result; the DPD's own result is never overwritten.
results.detail.chain.help: x is the target input, u = DPD(x) the pre-distorted PA input, y the PA output. A simulated stage comes from a learned surrogate, never from a measurement.
results.detail.baselines.help: Every column is scored against the same linear target reference_gain · x, with the same profile and valid range. Nothing is normalised separately, so power differences stay visible.
results.detail.coverage.body: Largest fitted |x| {fitted} · peak |u| {peak} · {fraction} of the pre-distorted samples above the fitted peak.
results.detail.scaling.body: Amplitude units: {units} · input scaling: {scaling} · reference gain: {gain}.
results.detail.scaling.uncalibrated: No physical calibration: absolute output power (dBm) and efficiency are not derived from these numbers.
run.metrics.apply: This run applied a trained DPD to the test split; there is no training history. Open the result for the signal chain and the scores.
results.charts.help: Drawn from plots-v1 data the worker computed from the evaluated arrays (the spectral profile's Welch estimator). Hiding a trace in the legend changes nothing in the evaluation.
results.charts.none: No derived plot data for this result (it was evaluated before plots-v1). Re-evaluate the run to produce it.
chart.am.title: AM-AM
chart.pm.title: AM-PM
compare.title: Compare results
compare.pick: Pick at least two results on the Results page to compare them.
compare.comparable: Same protocol: these results may be ranked; the best value per metric is marked.
compare.incompatible: Different protocols: the results are shown side by side and are not ranked.
compare.spectrum: Spectrum overlay (primary trace of each result)
compare.spectrum.mismatch: The results were evaluated on different frequency axes; no overlay is drawn.
run.metrics.fromHistory: Curves come from the run's history log.
results.export.help: A package carries the resolved configuration, the results under every profile, the plot data, the checkpoints of every referenced run, the reports and the commands to reproduce. Full is private and complete; share leaves your PA data, worker logs and machine paths out and says so.
experiments.import.help: An experiment package exported by OpenDPD Studio (.zip). Every file hash is verified before anything is written; a damaged or unsupported package is refused with the reason.
